data.key: Knight Of The Sepulcher ~ Fortitude Of The Crypt
data.name: Fortitude of the Crypt
data.description: At 8th level, a knight of the sepulcher gains immunity to poison. He also gains darkvision 60 feet if he does not already possess it. This ability replaces the aura of despair ability.
